<parameter=code>
# Move LEFT repeatedly, clearing green blocks as they spawn
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
print(f"Start: white={white}")

moves = 0
for i in range(60):  # Up to 60 moves
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
    
    if white <= 0:
        print(f"White reached 0! Level complete?")
        print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
        break
    
    # Check for green blocks
    green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    pink = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P']
    
    if pink:
        print(f"PINK block appeared at move {moves}! Stopping.")
        break
    
    if green:
        print(f"Move {moves}: {len(green)} green blocks spawned, clearing...")
        clicks = []
        for g in green:
            rows = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
            cols = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
            center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
            center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
            clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})
        result = action(clicks)
        
        # Check state after clear
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
        green = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
        print(f"  After clear: white={white}, green={len(green)}")
        if result.get('game_over'):
            print("  Game over!")
            break
        continue
    
    # No green blocks, move LEFT
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    moves += 1
    
    if result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"Game over after {moves} moves!")
        break
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Level completed after {moves} moves!")
        break
    
    if (i + 1) % 10 == 0:
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        nodes = seg['nodes']
        white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
        print(f"  Move {moves}: white={white}")

# Final state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
white = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W')
purple = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p')
green = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N'])
pink = len([n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'P'])
print(f"\nFinal: white={white}, purple={purple}, green={green}, pink={pink}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
